terms.definition: An aggressive overhead smash hit directed forcefully into the opponent court.
Action of players close to the net to deflect the ball coming from the opponent by reaching higher than the top of the net.
A precise overhead pass using fingertips to position the ball for an attacking spiker.
A defensive passing technique executed to stop a spiked or fast-moving ball from hitting the floor.
A specialized defensive player wearing a contrasting jersey who cannot attack, block, or serve (in standard FIVB rules).
A serve that lands directly on the opponent court or is mishandled on reception without another touch.
